c: Open the article in the Knowledge Center and choose Retire. Only the latest published version can be retired, by its author or reviser, or the knowledge base's owner or a manager.
say: Open the article in the Knowledge Center and choose retire. Only the latest published version can be retired, by its author or reviser, or by the knowledge base's owner or a manager.

c: The Retire Confirmation asks whether another article replaces it. Choose Yes and Select Article by number or short description, or No.
say: The retire confirmation asks whether another article replaces this one. Choose yes and search for the replacement by number or short description, or choose no.

c: Retire Article starts the knowledge base's retire flow. With Instant Retire it is retired at once.
say: Retire article starts the knowledge base's retire flow. With the instant flow, the article is retired at once.

c: Every version of the article is retired. It no longer appears in search or in knowledge lists.
say: Every version of the article is retired, and it no longer appears in search or in knowledge lists.

c: With Approval Retire, it waits in Pending retirement: the owner and managers get KB… is awaiting approval. Rejected, it goes back.
say: With the approval flow, it waits in pending retirement, and the owner and managers are asked to approve. If they reject it, the article goes back to the state it had.

c: A reader who follows an old link lands on the replacement: The article KB… has been retired and replaced with the current article. Without one, it can't be opened.
say: A reader who follows an old link lands on the replacement, with a message that the old article was retired. Without a replacement, readers can no longer open it.
